import json,subprocess,sys,random
def expected_sums(inputs):
    P=len(inputs);R=len(inputs[0]) if P else 0;D=len(inputs[0][0]) if R else 0
    out=[]
    for q in range(R):
        v=[0]*D
        for r in range(P):
            for i in range(D):v[i]+=inputs[r][q][i]
        out.append(v)
    return out,P,R,D
def is_safe(st,inputs,P,R,D,exp):
    for r in range(P):
        for q,vec in enumerate(st["delivered"][r]):
            if vec!=exp[q]:return False
    for s in st["slots"]:
        q=s["seq"];acc=[0]*D
        for rr in s["ranks"]:
            for i in range(D):acc[i]+=inputs[rr][q][i]
        if acc!=s["sum"]:return False
    return True
def is_done(st,P,R):
    return all(len(st["delivered"][r])==R for r in range(P))
def walk(start,ids,edges):
    cur=start;states=[start]
    for eid in ids:
        if eid==-1:states.append(cur);continue
        if eid<0 or eid>=len(edges):return None
        s,a,t=edges[eid]
        if s!=cur:return None
        cur=t;states.append(cur)
    return cur,states
def check(req,resp):
    P=len(req["inputs"]);R=len(req["inputs"][0]) if P else 0;D=len(req["inputs"][0][0]) if R else 0
    exp,_,_,_=expected_sums(req["inputs"])
    states=req["states"];edges=req["edges"];start=req["start"]
    done=[is_done(st,P,R) for st in states]
    safe=[is_safe(st,req["inputs"],P,R,D,exp) for st in states]
    if resp["safe"]:
        if resp["safety"] is not None:return "safetrue"
    else:
        w=resp["safety"]
        if w is None:return "nowit"
        r=walk(start,w["prefix"],edges)
        if r is None:return "badsp"
        end,_=r
        if safe[end]:return "safebad"
    if resp["terminates"]:
        if resp["liveness"] is not None:return "termtrue"
    else:
        w=resp["liveness"]
        if w is None:return "noliv"
        r=walk(start,w["prefix"],edges)
        if r is None:return "badlp"
        mid,ps=r
        if any(done[s] for s in ps):return "pdon"
        if not w["loop"]:return "emptyloop"
        r2=walk(mid,w["loop"],edges)
        if r2 is None:return "badloop"
        e2,ls=r2
        if e2!=mid:return "notclosed"
        if any(done[s] for s in ls):return "ldon"
        Su=set(ls)
        en={a:set(e[0] for e in edges if e[1]==a) for a in set(f["action"] for f in req["fairness"])}
        used=set(edges[eid][1] for eid in w["loop"] if eid!=-1)
        for f in req["fairness"]:
            a=f["action"];es=en[a]
            if f["mode"]=="weak":
                if Su<=es and a not in used:return "weakfail"
            else:
                if (Su&es) and a not in used:return "strongfail"
    return None
random.seed(808)
reqs=[]
for _ in range(4000):
    P=random.randint(1,2);R=random.randint(1,3);D=random.randint(0,2)
    inputs=[[[random.randint(-2,2) for _ in range(D)] for _ in range(R)] for _ in range(P)]
    n=random.randint(1,8)
    states=[]
    for i in range(n):
        delivered=[[[random.randint(-4,4) for _ in range(D)] for _ in range(random.randint(0,R))] for _ in range(P)]
        states.append({"delivered":delivered,"slots":[]})
    edges=[];seen=set()
    for _ in range(random.randint(0,16)):
        s=random.randrange(n);t=random.randrange(n);a=random.choice(["a","b","c","d","e"])
        if (s,a,t) in seen:continue
        seen.add((s,a,t));edges.append([s,a,t])
    start=random.randrange(n)

outs=[json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.splitlines()]
